requirements.requirement: On node1, run /usr/local/bin/os-comparison-worker as a managed service named inventory-worker.
requirements.summary: A systemd unit named inventory-worker.service was installed with the requested ExecStart, enabled, and observed active with the expected command line. It remained enabled and active after a verified reboot, with Result=success and NRestarts=0.

requirements.requirement: Run inventory-worker under the dedicated inventorysvc account.
requirements.summary: The initially absent inventorysvc account was created as a system account with its own UID/GID and a nologin shell. Both before and after reboot, the unit declared User/Group=inventorysvc and the live process UID matched the account UID.

overall_summary: All material task outcomes are satisfied. The restart protocol is complete and coherent: a healthy pre-restart service and boot ID were captured, restart scheduling was acknowledged, the node returned with a different boot ID, and the service, account ownership, executable hash, and process stability were revalidated. Fixed lifecycle boot identities independently corroborate the transition.

operational_hygiene.summary: No unnecessary mutations were identified. Account creation, unit installation and labeling, daemon reload, enablement, and startup directly established the requested service. The transient reboot schedule and reboot were required by the provider-wide restart protocol and were cleared by the reboot. Final observations show no failed services, package-health damage, unexpected listening sockets, or abandoned temporary files; the inventory-worker PrivateTmp directory is expected service state.
